messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High tail latency and backpressure observed on inference-runtime (us-west-2). Error rate up x3, SSE connections showing heavy write amplification. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/streaming-backpressure
ryan (oncall): I'm paged. Looking now. Any customer impact seen?
marta: seeing GPU queue growth + redis kv churn. Most of the hot paths are SSE/push frames creating many small cache writes. If we mute external streaming writes we should drop the write rate substantially.
sam (eng-runtime): agree. Plan: flip public push-streaming off (keep admin/internal streams). Feature flag: sse_push_public. Rollout via ops-api. Quick toggle, low-risk, immediate effect.
ryan (oncall): what's the exact command to run?
sam (eng-runtime): opsctl example:
```
opsctl feature-toggle --name sse_push_public --state off --reason "mitigate backpressure"
```
(or POST to https://ops-api.internal/flags)
kai (oncall-2): I'll coordinate the rollout and take handoff. Paging pagerduty for eng-runtime for visibility.
liz (customer-success): I'll prepare a short customer note: "We have temporarily disabled streaming responses to stabilize latency. Clients will fall back to polling; expected restoration in ~30-45 minutes." Any recommended client fallback snippet?
sam (eng-runtime): share header snippet to force poll mode:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Response-Mode: poll" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"input":"..."}'
```
This will preserve correctness, but adds ~1-2s latency per request depending on polling cadence.
ryan (oncall): executing toggle now. opsctl run ...
metrics-bot: feature toggle request received by ops-api (req_id=op-9b3).
ryan (oncall): toggle complete. sse_push_public=false returned OK. Watching metrics.
metrics-bot: 60s window: tail latency p95 -> down 55%, inflight queue length down 48%. Errors trending down.
marta: KV size and redis eviction events dropping. Memory pressure easing. Looks effective.
liz (customer-success): Posted short update to status.redwood: "Degraded streaming responses in us-west-2; streaming temporarily disabled for public clients. Fallback to polling recommended. ETA 45m."
kai (oncall-2): I'm taking 2h watch. Notes for handoff: flag sse_push_public=false, rollout scope=public, rollback command: opsctl feature-toggle --name sse_push_public --state on, follow-up: eng-runtime to run RCA on push frame aggregation.
ryan (oncall): leaving handoff. Added troubleshooting notes to incident doc.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated: live traffic shaping applied (public streaming muted). Follow-up task created: ENG-1245 (RCA: streaming write amplification).
metrics-bot: continued monitoring shows stable baselines for 20m.
kai (oncall-2): will keep an eye and coordinate restore when queues steady for 30m.
sam (eng-runtime): post-mortem: evaluate batching small push writes and a smarter mux gate to avoid full mute in future.
kai (oncall-2): acknowledged, closing active paging. If anything flares, re-open channel. :thumbsup:
